topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I never thought I'd see you again, you fuzzy, long-lost friend. There you were, tucked away at the yard sale, among the forgotten things. I could barely breathe as I reached for you, my fingers trembling as they traced the familiar, worn patches of your fur. I clutched you close, trying to remember the last time we were together. It’s been so long, and yet, here you are. I should have taken better care of you, shouldn’t have let you go. But now, I have a second chance. I promise, things will be different this time.
